      About Me

      Hello! I'm Wendayew, a full-stack developer and fourth-year Software Engineering student at Dire Dawa University in Dire Dawa, Ethiopia. I build reliable, maintainable applications from frontend client interfaces through backend services and database storage.

      My practical development experience centers around two real production platforms: architecting BuildBid Ethiopia (Construction Gebya) — an auction-based digital marketplace connecting contractors, suppliers, and transporters across Ethiopia — and engineering the 5-Star Hotel Management System for operational reservation workflows.

      I enjoy writing clean code, translating complex business processes into intuitive user flows, and working in collaborative software engineering teams.

      Undergraduate Student — Fourth Year @ Dire Dawa University

      2021 – Present · Dire Dawa, Ethiopia

      • Pursuing Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering, building strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems.
      • Deep coursework and project implementation across frontend development, backend services, relational database modeling, and software testing.
      • Actively collaborating in student engineering teams, following Agile practices, peer code reviews, and structured software architecture.

      Lead Full-Stack Developer @ BuildBid Ethiopia (Construction Gebya)

      2024 – Present · Live Production Platform

      • Architected and deployed BuildBid Ethiopia, an auction-based digital marketplace connecting contractors, construction-material suppliers, and transporters with Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
      • Engineered multi-sided user workflows supporting project bidding, supplier catalogs, transport coordination, and transparent pricing.
      • Implemented containerized backend services using Docker and automated cloud deployments on Render.

      Full-Stack Developer @ 5-Star Hotel Management System

      2024 · Production Project

      • Engineered and shipped the 5-Star Hotel Management System MVP using React, Supabase, and JavaScript, handling room reservations, guest bookings, and operational management.
      • Architected responsive, performant client interfaces with modular component patterns and clean state management.
      • Integrated relational backend databases, real-time client subscriptions, and automated cloud deployments on Vercel.

      Mobile & Database Engineer @ Systems & APIs

      2023 – Present

      • Building cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter and Dart with fluid 60fps UI performance and native Android SDK tools.
      • Designing relational database schemas, foreign-key relationships, and indexing strategies in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Supabase.
      • Developing RESTful API microservices in Node.js and TypeScript with data validation, JWT authentication, and secure password hashing.
